candidates.name: Kilosort4
candidates.evidence: Widely used maintained sorter with peer-reviewed hybrid benchmarks and 2026 AIND head-to-head evidence; dense-probe assumptions and ten-second fixture require explicit same-data run.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: DARTsort
candidates.evidence: Actively developed modular drift sorter; official repository explicitly does not recommend production use yet.
candidates.role: research contender, explicit maintainer production warning

candidates.name: MountainSort5
candidates.evidence: Official code is current local specialist family; this run is not a multi-sorter best claim.

candidates.name: SpyKINGCIRCUS2 / Tridesclous2 / Lupin
candidates.evidence: Current SpikeInterface in-house alternatives; geometry/noise can change which method wins.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: VanillaSort
candidates.evidence: 15 September 2026 preprint improves detection over SimSort on HybridJanelia; no evaluated fixture parity/code and weights verified.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: SimSort / SpikeSift
candidates.evidence: Recent learning/drift-oriented methods; published comparisons differ in datasets, SNR filtering and metric.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

current_best_claim_scope: Exact executed custom input/split/metric protocol, not best within our small inspected local set
current_reference: MountainSort5 scheme 1 plus primary matched-GT accuracy and posthoc all-event F1
current_reference_limitations: Stationary ten-second simulation cannot establish real neuropixels sorting quality.
Matched-GT score can hide false positive/oversplit units; retain all-event diagnostic.
Hardware/runtime and specialist development effort differ.
No transplant of published hybrid scores.
recommended_next_comparator: Prospectively pin/run Kilosort4, MountainSort5, SpyKINGCIRCUS2 and Tridesclous2 on identical voltage, geometry and ten-second selection; include all returned units and fixed matching. Add longer independent fixtures and DARTsort research tier. Tune only training/simulated development seeds.
switching_assessment: NO GENERAL REPLACEMENT RECOMMENDATION. Current evidence supports a bounded code-synthesis/pilot comparison to the named local reference. Establish prospective same-input/split/metric contender runs, biological/source replication, calibration and runtime/reliability before switching production tools.
limitations: Stationary ten-second simulation cannot establish real neuropixels sorting quality.

negative_findings: SpikeForest is historically useful but the 2026 AIND paper notes lack of recent algorithm updates.
